titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, BBC News
mainText: Jharkhand police used tear gas and water cannons to disperse student protesters.
At least 47 people killed in earthquake in Colombia.
Russia's top court banned an opposition anti-war party from participating in voting.
A former gang member will stand trial for the 1994 murder of Tupac Shakur.
The United Kingdom and France are preparing for a heat wave as western Europe experiences its third hottest year on record to date.
